"""Generation 1: Improved PII redactor with robust phone number recognition and filtering."""
import re

PATTERNS = [
    ("EMAIL", re.compile(r"[\w.]+@[\w]+\.\w+")),
    ("SSN", re.compile(r"\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b")),
    ("CREDIT_CARD", re.compile(r"\b\d{16}\b")),
]

# Comprehensive phone pattern capturing international, dotted, spaced, and bracketed formats
PHONE_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"""(?x)
    (?:
        \+?\d{1,3}[-.\s]?              # Optional international country code
        (?:\(?\d{3}\)?|\d{3})[-.\s]?   # Area code
        \d{3}[-.\s]?\d{4}              # Exchange and subscriber number
        (?:\s*(?:ext|x|extension)\s*\d+)? # Optional extension
    )
    |
    \b\d{10}\b                         # 10-digit contiguous numbers
    """
)

def find_pii(text):
    """Return a list of (start, end, label) spans that contain PII."""
    spans = []
    
    # Standard patterns
    for label, pattern in PATTERNS:
        for m in pattern.finditer(text):
            spans.append((m.start(), m.end(), label))
            
    # Phone number extraction with context filtering
    for m in PHONE_PATTERN.finditer(text):
        start, end = m.start(), m.end()
        matched_str = m.group()
        
        # Check preceding context for order/part/model number false positives
        prefix = text[max(0, start - 25):start].lower()
        if any(kw in prefix for kw in ["order #", "order number", "part #", "model #", "invoice #", "report"]):
            # Ensure it's not explicitly labeled as phone in context
            if not any(phone_kw in prefix for phone_kw in ["phone", "call", "text", "mobile", "cell"]):
                continue
                
        # Skip if it matches an SSN pattern (3-2-4 dashed digits)
        if re.match(r"^\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}$", matched_str):
            continue
            
        spans.append((start, end, "PHONE"))
        
    return spans
